mechanismCorrection.problem: Dynamic execution state had been hard-coded into validators created before M2 closed, causing repeated false drift and re-reading loops.
controls: The M3 master-plan validator validates only immutable plan identity/hash/structure.
The M3 state-sync validator derives state from canonical M2 closure plus current M3 evidence instead of expecting M1/M2 literals.
The M3 Phase-A continuity validator validates the live schema/control state and G2-B terminal safety without stale epoch assumptions.
The canonical-authority validator separates current authority from historical requests, event artifacts, aliases and tombstones.
Historical never-executed authority is inertized without falsely marking it consumed.
Remaining M3 work is a finite queue sourced only from the M2 locked inventory; no new audit tranche is permitted.

f2.singleAuthorityRule: Frozen master-plan identity + continuity safety invariants + explicit M3 validator authority + current M3 evidence/tombstone registry. PR and historical execute/request/validator artifacts are non-authoritative.

materialization.reason: GitHub contents connector applied the source-only pieces as sequential commits.
